#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
typedef long long ll;
const ll N=1000000007;
using namespace std;

ll power_mod(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    for (ll i=0; i<exp; i++) {
        result = (result * base) % mod;
    }
    return result;
}

ll fast_modpow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    for (ll i=0; i<exp; i++) {
        result = (result * base) % N;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k % p == 1) {
        cout << fast_modpow(p, p);
        return 0;
    }
    if (k % p == 0) {
        cout << fast_modpow(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }
    ll a = 1;
    while (true) {
        if ((p - 1) % a != 0) {
            a++;
            continue;
        }
        if (power_mod(k, a, p) == 1) {
            break;
        } else {
            a++;
        }
    }
    cout << fast_modpow(p, (p - 1) / a);
    return 0;
}
